players.product: Special graphite parts for single-crystal silicon manufacturing and SiC-coated graphite products (susceptors) for Si and SiC epitaxial applications

quarterly_data.quarter: Toyo Tanso amended semi-annual report: H1 FY2025 (11-07-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Correction (amended semi-annual report filed November 7, 2025) to the product-line figures for the six months to June 30, 2025: special graphite electronics applications corrected to -30.7% year on year (originally reported -41.5%), on sharp declines in compound-semiconductor manufacturing for SiC semiconductors and single-crystal silicon manufacturing; general industrial -5.4% (originally -10.7%); special graphite products overall -16.3% (originally -23.6%), sales JPY 10,203 million (originally JPY 9,310 million). SiC-coated graphite products are now stated BELOW the prior-year half (originally reported above it): Si semiconductor applications grew but SiC semiconductor applications fell sharply. The three major products (SiC-coated graphite, C/C composites, graphite sheets) corrected to -12.4% (originally flat year on year); composite and other products -7.2%, sales JPY 7,910 million (originally +3.3%, JPY 8,803 million). Corrected H1 orders: special graphite JPY 8,168 million (75.1% of the prior-year half), backlog JPY 5,245 million; composite and other products JPY 6,981 million (74.9%), backlog JPY 5,374 million (59.6%); group totals unchanged.
quarterly_data.figure: Special graphite sales JPY 10,203 million (-16.3%); composite and other JPY 7,910 million (-7.2%); three major products -12.4%
